e4b-product._note: The laptop product as agreed 2026-10-05: E4B QAT Q4_K_XL, the Agent's share of the one 128K pool (131072 minus the character's 32768), history kept to the whole window, thinking off, rg/fd shipped.

e4b-product-agent-lora._note: e4b-product with the Agent adapter trained on the teacher's runs inside the framework (agent-fw1), loaded as the product loads one.

e4b-laptop-fw1._note: The laptop product as the owner runs it from 2026-10-07: one 64K window the Agent owns, agent-fw1, thinking off.

e4b-laptop-fw1-high._note: e4b-laptop-fw1 with thinking high, the setting the owner tried in the web UI (2026-10-07).

e4b-laptop-base._note: The laptop product as it runs from 2026-10-07 15:00: the laptop cleared the Agent adapter (agent-fw1 looped on ls for a greeting); E4B alone, 64K, thinking off.

e4b-product-agent-lora2._note: e4b-product with the second Agent adapter (agent-fw2: tool, scope and MCP tasks re-recorded in the final framework, plus repo tasks).

e4b-mini._note: E4B in the mini-swe-agent harness (one bash tool, bench/mini_templates.json), the harness of the open trajectories; step limit 100.

e4b-product-ms1._note: The product with machine-spirit-v1: one adapter trained on the machine spirit's chats (written by the laptop's agent, lines kept by the app's rules) and the Agent's tool work (agent-rows-fw2). Paired against fw-v3-lora (agent-fw1).

teacher-38._note: The one teacher (owner, 2026-10-07): Qwen3.8-27B (Apache 2.0) UD-Q4_K_XL, all on GPU, the Agent's 64K window, thinking high so its reasoning is recorded with its answers. Also plays the simulated user in scenario cards it records. Dev box only. Says it is the product's model (self_model) so its rows teach the student what it is. Thinking capped at 1,024 tokens a step (2026-10-07): uncapped it wrote 20-40K characters of thinking per conversation, ran into the 16K output cap 4 times in 29, and small students learn short reasoning better than long (2502.12143).

judge-gemma._note: The scenario judge (owner, 2026-10-07): Gemma 4 31B, another family than the teacher so it does not grade its own kind's answers; IQ3_XXS agreed 99% with Q4 as the character pipeline's checker. 48K a slot: it reads whole conversations with their tool results (the longest pilot one 25K tokens, 2026-10-08); three 32K slots took 18,506 MiB, so about 1,840 a 32K slot, 3,000 a 48K one with room.

e4b-laptop-fw2._note: The urgent agent-fw2 (owner 2026-10-07: distil Qwen3.8 at thinking high now): tool tasks and scenario conversations the teacher recorded, with and without its reasoning; E4B 64K, thinking off.

teacher-38-sim._note: The simulated user when a student plays scenario cards: the same teacher model, IQ3 so it fits beside E4B. Plays the user only (no tools). VRAM from the IQ3 measurement (2026-10-08: 12,720 MiB with one 64K slot, 15,302 with two): base 10,200, a 32K slot about 1,300.

e4b-laptop-base-scen._note: e4b-laptop-base-high playing held-out scenario cards against the simulated user on its own server (teacher-38-sim). VRAM from E4B's layout: 4 of its 24 KV-holding layers are global (16 KB a token), so a 64K slot is about 1.05 GB; weights on the GPU 2.5 GB (the 1.5 GB per-layer table stays in RAM) plus vision and buffers.

e4b-laptop-fw2-scen._note: e4b-laptop-fw2-high playing held-out scenario cards against the simulated user on its own server (teacher-38-sim).

teacher-38-iq3._note: teacher-38 at IQ3_XXS so four conversations run side by side (measured 2026-10-08: 12,720 MiB with one 64K slot, 15,302 with two; four fit an idle GPU, five do not) (2026-10-07: at Q4 two slots made 12-15 conversations an hour, one stuck conversation halved it). The 27B IQ3 ranked within the threshold of Q4 as a teacher before (dev box 2026-09-29: 1.54 vs 1.46). A conversation past 15 minutes (time_scale 0.5 of the cards' 30) is a loop that never becomes a row.
